indicators.name: Functionality
indicators.target: All  toilets are available and usable (WC units meant for users with reduced mobility are excluded for this calculation as almost all WCs are non-functional)
indicators.green: All  toilets are available and usable
indicators.yellow: More than 50% of the toilets (urinals and cubicles) are available and usable
indicators.red: Less than 50% of the toilets (urinals and cubicles) are available or usable

indicators.name: Gender sensitivity
indicators.target: Toilets are clearly separated and labelled for all genders
indicators.green: Toilets for third gender or gender neutral toilets exist and these are clearly labelled in addition to male and female toilets
indicators.yellow: Separate toilets for male/female use exist and are clearly labelled (and provide privacy for users)
indicators.red: Separate toilets exist but not clearly labelled

indicators.name: Soap/water
indicators.target: Soap is available for hand washing (soap availability)
indicators.green: Has water and soap or liquid handwash
indicators.yellow: No soap; HW station with only water; tank or pipe with water elimination channel
indicators.red: Has no water; No hand washing facility; common tank/multipurpose tap with no scope for water elimination

indicators.name: Hand washing station
indicators.target: Hand wash stations are available (sinks, multipurpose taps, and common tanks with a channel for water elimination were also considered, even in the presence of a dysfunctional sink, the common tap was also considered and average was calculated) - in case of multiple sinks, average to be calculated
indicators.green: Hand washing station available - fully functional (functional tap/water, and proper drainage)
indicators.yellow: Hand washing station available with drainage issues/broken/not in use/dysfunctional tap/sink available but the pipe has been disabled; common tank has water with a channel for water elimination
indicators.red: No hand hygiene station available

indicators.name: Dustbins
indicators.target: Functional waste collection containers are available
indicators.green: Bins are provided within all cubicles or alternatively for the toilet block; both male and female blocks have dustbins.
indicators.yellow: The female block has a bin/There is a common bin within the toilet block - cannot be comfortably used by women
indicators.red: No bins within the toilet block/ garbage cans outiside the toilet serve as dustbins

indicators.name: Latrines
indicators.target: Latrines are clean - free from stains of excreta
indicators.green: All units are clean
indicators.yellow: More than 50% of the units are clean
indicators.red: Less than 50% of the units are clean

indicators.name: Floor
indicators.target: Floor and work surfaces appear clean
indicators.green: All units are clean
indicators.yellow: More than 50% of the units are clean
indicators.red: Less than 50% of the units are clean

indicators.name: Exteriors
indicators.target: The exterior of the toilet is kept clean and free from stagnant water, animal or human feces, and other solid waste
indicators.green: The exterior of the toilet is clean and well maintained
indicators.yellow: Aesthetics are compromised by graffiti and posters
indicators.red: The exteriors are in an extremely bad condition - feces; wine bottles; condoms; sewage are seen

indicators.name: Walls
indicators.target: Walls are free from stains and graffiti
indicators.green: All units are clean
indicators.yellow: More than 50% of the units are clean
indicators.red: Less than 50% of the units are clean

indicators.name: Inclusivity
indicators.target: At least one functional improved toilet meets the needs of people with reduced mobility
indicators.green: One or more functional toilet meets need of people with reduced mobility
indicators.yellow: Toilet meets needs of people with reduced mobility but is not functional or toilet is functional but only partially meets needs of people with reduced mobility
indicators.red: No toilets for disabled users

indicators.name: Ventilation
indicators.target: Sufficient functioning environmental ventilation (natural or mechanical) is available
indicators.green: Ventilation is sufficient and functional in all areas
indicators.yellow: Insufficient ventilation
indicators.red: No ventilation

indicators.name: Electricity
indicators.target: Toilet has a functional and well-maintained electricity source
indicators.green: Electricity source exists, is functional and well-maintained
indicators.yellow: Electricity exists but partly functional
indicators.red: Frequent issues with electricity reported

indicators.name: Door/locks
indicators.target: Functional doors and locks
indicators.green: All units have functional doors and locks
indicators.yellow: More than 50% of the units have functional doors and locks
indicators.red: Less than 50% of the units have functional doors and locks

indicators.name: Natural lighting
indicators.target: Day time lighting/natural lighting is adequate
indicators.green: Adequate day time lighting is seen for all units
indicators.yellow: More than 50% spaces are well lit
indicators.red: Less than 50% of the spaces are well lit

indicators.name: Lighting - artificial
indicators.target: Latrines are adequately lit at night
indicators.green: All latrines have functioning lighting
indicators.yellow: Lighting infrastructure exists but not functioning
indicators.red: Not adequately lit or poor lighting infrastructure; common lighting outside the cubicles

indicators.name: Damages/safety
indicators.target: Damages to physical infrastructure affecting the safety of the users
indicators.green: No damages observed
indicators.yellow: Damages observed and these can cause potential injury (wear and tear of floors; man-hole lids being damaged; leakage of water)
indicators.red: The physical infrastructure is damaged and can cause grevious injury to users

indicators.name: Equipment
indicators.target: Appropriate and well-maintained materials (e.g detergent, mops, buckets) for cleaning for a range of different areas and surfaces are available and sufficient
indicators.green: All materials are sufficient and in a good condition
indicators.yellow: Available but not sufficient or in a poor condition; cannot be assessed but the toilets are clean
indicators.red: No materials available

indicators.name: PPE
indicators.target: Adequate PPE is available at all times and in sufficient quantities for all cleaning staff (at least glove and mask)
indicators.green: All members have adequate PPE
indicators.yellow: Some but not all staff have PPE or PPE available in poor condition
indicators.red: Not available

indicators.name: OM Protocol
indicators.target: A protocol and effective system are in place for ongoing operation and maintenance
indicators.green: Toilet has a toilet operator/cleaning staff and they clean it everyday and maintain it
indicators.yellow: System in place but operation and maintenance is poor; cannot be determined but the toilet apparently is being cleaned
indicators.red: Not available

indicators.name: Fecal sludge removal
indicators.target: Efficient fecal sludge removal - drainage is efficient
indicators.green: Efficient drainage
indicators.yellow: Few units have drainage blocks affecting fecal sludge elimination
indicators.red: Entire drainage is an issue

indicators.name: Grey water
indicators.target: Grey water elimination is efficient
indicators.green: Grey water disposal is efficient
indicators.yellow: Grey water stagnation seen in few areas
indicators.red: Grey water stagnantion is a major issue

indicators.name: Water availability
indicators.target: Water is available at the time the WASH assessment is carried out
indicators.green: Water is available throughout the facility
indicators.yellow: Water is available at more than 50% end points/water is available at all points but water leakage or any form of wastage reported
indicators.red: Water shortage is reported/ frequent episodes of water shortage is reported/ issues with motor or water tank /inadequate water capacity - frequent operation of motor consuming more electricty

indicators.name: Flush tanks
indicators.target: Flush tanks are in working condition in all toilets (in the absence of flush tank - bucket with a working tap for pour flush; if water needs to be taken inside the cubicles, then the size of the bucket should be considered - size should facilitate pour flush)
indicators.green: Present in all units and functional (all units have working tap and a bucket)
indicators.yellow: Present and functional in 50% units; the water is piped inside the unit but the size of the bucket is small (the user will need more than one bucket of this size for pour flush)
indicators.red: Present and functional in less than 50% units; the water source is outside the cubcile and the size of the bucket is very small and doesnt allow for pour flush

indicators.name: Self cleansing tool
indicators.target: An element for self cleaning - Tap/Bucket/mug or health faucet or tissue paper in all the toilets
indicators.green: Present in all units and functional
indicators.yellow: Present and functional in 50% units
indicators.red: Present and functional in less than 50% units; No element for self cleansing seperately

indicators.name: Plumbing setting
indicators.target: The facility has piped water supplies on premises (plumbing setting)
indicators.green: Water is piped inside the toilet to all individual units or cubicles
indicators.yellow: Water is piped inside the toilet but not to all individual units or cubicles; Common water tank is present and is clean
indicators.red: No piped water connection to the toilet; the common tank from which water is fetched is extremely unclean with algae and other deposits
